Puzzles represent structured exercises in navigating ambiguity.

pages.quote: “To teach how to live without certainty, and yet without being paralyzed by hesitation, is perhaps the chief thing that philosophy, in our age, can still do for those who study it.”

pages.body:
### Where this comes from

Adults spend their working lives on questions nobody has framed yet: what a community needs, what a job actually is, what to do when the instructions run out.

### What we mean by a puzzle

Not a jigsaw, and not a riddle with a trick. A puzzle here is any situation where the shape of the answer is unknown and progress has to be made anyway.
pages.description: Thirteen years of practice at recognising ambiguity.

pages.intro: School is unusually good at problems with known answers and unusually quiet about everything else. We are building the other half.
